inventory.notes: Early return at the top of init(), always (StealthSecurityState.ownsSync()): the engine never creates the onecrl, intermediates or cert-revocations clients, so Remote Settings registers no client, no sync observer and no poll-end observer for the bucket security-state and no request is made for its collections. Mozilla's lines are untouched; the logic is in security/manager/ssl/stealth/StealthSecurityState.sys.mjs. The security state comes from security_state/ the core copies into the profile, generated by the engine's generate mode.
